Distribution. The species is thus far known from south-eastern Queensland and north-eastern New South Wales (Fig. 70). Host-plants. The type series was collected in series from Acacia polybotrya and A. spectabilis and as singletons from A. ixiophylla and A. semilunata (Table 1), suggesting that the former two may be larval hosts for it (Table 2).
Distribution. Omalium golovatchi sp. nov. is known only from two localities in the southern part of Kemerovo Area, Russia (Fig. 21).
